CUSTOMARY.Definition: usual; done regularly as a habit

CAPTIVATED.Definition: strongly attracted and held the interest of

REALM.Definition: the world or area that belongs to or is ruled by someone

SUPERNATURAL.Definition: magical; impossible to explain by science

IMPLAUSIBLE.Definition: very hard to believe; unlikely to be true or possible

INTO ORBIT.Definition: onto a curved path that goes round and round the Earth

REALMS OF POSSIBILITY.Definition: the range of things that could happen

LOGICAL.Definition: sensible and expected, following on from what came before

FIGURATIVE.Definition: symbolic; not meant to be taken as real

CATCHY.Definition: easy to remember and pleasant to hear

SIDE NOTE.Definition: an extra comment that is not about the main subject

DEMARCATION.Definition: the official boundary marking where something begins

PROVISION.Definition: planning or rules made in advance

MINE.Definition: dig out of the ground and collect

FRAMEWORK.Definition: a set of rules and ideas that guide how something is done

SOVEREIGN TERRITORY.Definition: land or an area under the full control and laws of a country

GRAB YOURSELF.Definition: quickly buy or get for your own use

HOLDING UP.Definition: being accepted as valid or true

LUNAR.Definition: on or relating to the moon

TYCOON.Definition: a very rich and powerful businessperson
